Messages.Author: CthuluKitty
Messages.Body:
> Riiiiiiight... b/c the ventrue and the !ventrue could really use more
> tools to supplement their arsenals...

I'm not sure what you mean by this. Are you saying that those 2 clans
are overpowered and don't need new cards?

If you're suggesting that this is so for the Ventrue, I'm pretty much
with you. The !Ventrue on the other hand are quite a different story,
since they have a different discipline spread and lack access to many
of the sect and clan cards that make the Ventrue good.

In any case, I doubt that this promo vampire is any kind of freebie or
extra for the clan. It's probably just a preview of one that will be
released in Sword of Caine.

pretty much agree. !ven really do have stealth issues. and pre/for give
such a wonderful untapping team of Majesty and Freak Drive that just
cannot really be duplicated by !ven. and i find obtenebration far more
sane, and thematic, way of giving some stealth to them. it costs more
than obf at least; which says a lot on how sick Ven with obfuscate
really are. i don't find this vampire unnecessary. rather it seems just
right -- and the special does kind of encourage intra-sect violence. i'd
be amused whether Cardinal Sin: Insubordination makes an appearance in
intercepty !ven decks just to knock out your prey's sabbat minions.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


She's printed as group 5 in the SoC boosters, so might as well get used to the
idea now (with errata to the promo printing).

The only possible explanation for this error is that I changed her group during
the SoC playtest while lapsing on the memory of her having been printed earlier
as a promo. My sincere regrets for the error.
